mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 71 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and a Third Quarter moon phase.

There is a lot going on in the city. The Senior Center is launching a tri-shaw bike program offering free 30-minute rides for seniors on the Military Ridge State Trail, and the Recreation Department is currently hiring for seasonal positions like fitness instructors.
There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and pitchers at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local public safety, on August 1, a 71-year-old man was taken into custody on an outstanding arrest warrant after being stopped for driving at night without lights.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so stop by then. If you want to plan ahead, tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist.
